name: Red Corner
note: Only red lights the lantern at (5,4), so a prism is needed, and it must sit on column 2 where the white beam runs. From (2,y) red travels east along row y. Only row 4 leads to the lantern and the rock at (3,4) blocks it, so one piece is not enough. Prism at (2,2), then "\" at (5,2) turns red south into the lantern.
